remote_integrations.evidence: .github/workflows contains no active YAML workflows; historical templates remain under deployment/github-actions-disabled.

remote_integrations.reason: An external Workers build does not reserve the paired API/Pages approval, verify the exact frontend artifact, or execute compensating rollback.
remote_integrations.required_resolution: Disable the integration or bind it to the same exact paired-cutover contract and receipt chain before treating it as release evidence.

operator_rules: Do not claim release authority from an external build check that does not ratify the exact pair.
Do not deploy API or Pages independently in production.
Do not weaken local gates to compensate for unavailable remote CI.
Do not claim public self-serve readiness from deployment success alone.
